about: English chickpea and zucchini fritters: a size in parentheses ('1 (15 oz) can'), a range, 'a pinch' and 'a handful', no-amount lines and a 'for serving' line inside the list, a sauce group, yield and time on one line, shared steps followed by separate Oven and Air fryer passages with different times, and a substitution tip. Written independently as a held-out case.

expect.title: Crispy Chickpea & Zucchini Fritters

items: 1 (15 oz) can chickpeas, drained and patted dry
2 medium zucchini, coarsely grated and squeezed

ingredient_groups.name: For the yogurt sauce
items: a handful of fresh dill, chopped

preparation: Mash the chickpeas with a fork, leaving some texture
Add the zucchini, feta, green onions, garlic, flour, cumin, chili flakes, salt and pepper and mix well
Stir the yogurt, lemon juice and dill together and keep in the fridge until serving
Heat the oven to 220°C and line a tray with baking paper
Arrange the fritters, spray with olive oil and bake for 25 minutes, flipping halfway
Spray the basket and the fritters with olive oil and cook in batches for 12 minutes, flipping after 8 minutes
tips: if you don't have chickpea flour, regular flour or breadcrumbs work just as well
excluded: We're on a no-frying kick this month, so I tested these two ways and honestly both are winners
